body.apply_to: body, p, a, button, input, select, textarea, nav links, labels, captions

animations_and_keyframes._instructions: Implement ALL of these as @keyframes in the CSS. Every single one must be present in the final HTML file.

1_spotlight.purpose: Fades in + scales from offset center — use for hero background or featured images
1_spotlight.keyframes_css: @keyframes spotlight { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) translate(-2%, 2%); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translate(0, 0); } }

2_fade_in_up.purpose: Primary reveal animation — slides up 28px while fading in
2_fade_in_up.keyframes_css: @keyframes fadeInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
2_fade_in_up.stagger_rule: Apply delay-1 to second child, delay-2 to third child, delay-3 to fourth child within each section for cascade waterfall effect

3_gradient_shift.purpose: Moving gradient background — creates living luxury atmosphere

4_shiny_text.purpose: Sliding gold shine highlight across text — VERY premium feel
4_shiny_text.apply_css: background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--cream) 40%, var(--cream) 60%, var(--gold) 100%); background-size: 200% auto; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; animation: shinyText 8s linear infinite;
where_to_use: ONE section title accent word maximum per page
4_shiny_text.max_usage: 2 elements per page — overuse kills the premium feel

5_navbar_slide_down.purpose: Navbar entrance animation on page load
5_navbar_slide_down.keyframes_css: @keyframes navbarSlideDown { from { transform: translateY(-100%); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } }

6_navbar_dropdown.keyframes_css: @keyframes navbarDropdown { from { opacity: 0; transform: rotateX(-10deg) scale(0.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: rotateX(0) scale(1); } }
6_navbar_dropdown.apply_css: animation: navbarDropdown 0.2s ease forwards; transform-origin: top center;

7_loader_spin.keyframes_css: @keyframes loaderSpin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
7_loader_spin.apply_css: width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 3px solid var(--charcoal-3); border-top-color: var(--gold); border-radius: 50%; animation: loaderSpin 0.8s linear infinite;

8_accordion_down.purpose: Expands FAQ answer from 0 to full height
8_accordion_down.keyframes_css: @keyframes accordionDown { from { max-height: 0; opacity: 0; padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0; } to { max-height: 500px; opacity: 1; padding-top: 1rem; padding-bottom: 1.5rem; } }
8_accordion_down.apply_css: animation: accordionDown 0.3s ease-out forwards; overflow: hidden;

9_accordion_up.keyframes_css: @keyframes accordionUp { from { max-height: 500px; opacity: 1; padding-top: 1rem; padding-bottom: 1.5rem; } to { max-height: 0; opacity: 0; padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0; } }
9_accordion_up.apply_css: animation: accordionUp 0.3s ease-out forwards; overflow: hidden;

10_marquee.purpose: Infinite horizontal scroll for program/feature names
10_marquee.keyframes_css: @keyframes marqueeScroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
10_marquee.apply_css: display: flex; gap: 4rem; animation: marqueeScroll 25s linear infinite; width: max-content;
where_to_use: marquee banner between hero and about section

11_counter_animation.purpose: Animated number counting from 0 to target on scroll into view
11_counter_animation.js_code: function animateCounter(el) { const target = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-count')); const suffix = el.getAttribute('data-suffix') || ''; const duration = 2000; const start = performance.now(); function update(now) { const elapsed = now - start; const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1); const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3); el.textContent = Math.floor(eased * target).toLocaleString() + suffix; if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update); } requestAnimationFrame(update); }
11_counter_animation.trigger: IntersectionObserver with threshold 0.5 — animate once when element enters viewport
where_to_use: any number that should count up

12_shimmer_sweep.purpose: Diagonal light sweep across buttons and cards
12_shimmer_sweep.apply_css_on_pseudo: content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 50%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), transparent); transform: skewX(-20deg);

13_breathe_pulse.purpose: Subtle pulsing glow on text or elements — luxury breathing effect

14_rotate_border.purpose: Rotating conic gradient for shiny button border effect
14_rotate_border.keyframes_css: @keyframes rotateBorder { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
14_rotate_border.trigger: Paused by default, plays on hover

15_float.purpose: Gentle floating up and down — decorative elements

grain_overlay.description: Applied to body::before as fixed fullscreen texture — gives analog film feel
grain_overlay.full_css: body::before { content: ''; position: fixed; inset: 0; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)' opacity='0.035'/%3E%3C/svg%3E"); pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; }
where_to_use: body::before — always present on entire page

grid_pattern.description: Subtle gold grid lines in hero background for depth

gold_rule.full_css: .gold-rule { height: 1px; width: 100%; max-width: 200px; margin: 1.5rem auto; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, var(--gold) 50%, transparent 100%); border: none; }

custom_scrollbar.full_css: ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--charcoal); } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--gold); border-radius: 3px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--gold-hover); }

shiny_gold_button._instructions: This is the PREMIUM button component. Use for primary CTAs only — max 3-4 per page.
shiny_gold_button.full_css: .shiny-gold-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.8rem; background: var(--gold); color: var(--charcoal); padding: 1.1rem 2.8rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.4s ease; } .shiny-gold-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -2px; background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-hover), var(--gold), var(--cream), var(--gold)); border-radius: inherit; z-index: -2; animation: rotateBorder 4s linear infinite paused; } .shiny-gold-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 50%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), transparent); transform: skewX(-20deg); transition: left 0.6s ease; } .shiny-gold-btn:hover { background: var(--gold-hover); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(198, 167, 94, 0.3); } .shiny-gold-btn:hover::before { animation-play-state: running; } .shiny-gold-btn:hover::after { left: 150%; } .shiny-gold-btn:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; } .shiny-gold-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .shiny-gold-btn .btn-text { position: relative; z-index: 1; animation: breathePulse 3s ease-in-out infinite; }

secondary_button.full_css: .btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; color: var(--cream); padding: 1.1rem 2.2rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--charcoal-3); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); transform: translateY(-2px); }

scroll_reveal_system._instructions: Apply .reveal class to EVERY content element that should animate on scroll. Use IntersectionObserver.
scroll_reveal_system.full_css: .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .reveal.reveal-active { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; } .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; } .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; } .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; } .reveal-delay-5 { transition-delay: 0.5s; }
scroll_reveal_system.full_js: const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => { entries.forEach(entry => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('reveal-active'); } }); }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' }); document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

faq_data.q: Do I need prior fitness experience to join?
faq_data.a: Not at all! Our programs cater to all levels — from complete beginners to competitive athletes. Every new member gets a free fitness assessment and our trainers will guide you through the correct form and technique.
We're open Monday to Saturday from 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM, and Sunday from 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Our peak hours are 6-9 AM and 5-8 PM, so if you prefer a quieter workout, midday sessions are ideal.

faq_data.q: Can I freeze or cancel my membership?
faq_data.a: Yes! You can freeze your membership for up to 30 days per year at no extra cost. Cancellation requires a 15-day notice before your next billing cycle. No hidden fees, no questions asked.

faq_data.q: Do you offer personal training packages?
faq_data.a: Absolutely. Our Elite membership includes 4 PT sessions per month, or you can purchase standalone packages of 8, 16, or 24 sessions at discounted rates. Each session is 45 minutes with a certified trainer.
Yes, we have a dedicated parking area for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers with CCTV surveillance. Parking is complimentary for all members during their workout hours.

faq_data.q: What makes JERAI different from other gyms?
faq_data.a: Three things: world-class equipment that we update every 18 months, certified trainers who genuinely care about your progress (not just showing up), and a community culture where members motivate each other daily. Plus, our 15,000 sq ft facility gives you space to train without waiting for machines.

12_faq.js: Toggle .active class on FAQ items. Show/hide answer panel with accordion animations. Toggle + to − icon. Only one FAQ open at a time (close others when one opens).
